note: No earmark requests exist for David Jolly (FL-13, Mar 2014-Jan 2017) or Gwen Graham (FL-2, Jan 2015-Jan 2017). The House and Senate stopped accepting earmark (congressionally directed spending) requests from the 112th Congress (2011) until the House Appropriations Committee reopened them as Community Project Funding for FY2022 (requests filed in spring 2021). Every one of their years falls inside that moratorium, so the universe of requests is empty, not missing.
